name: The Crown of Will
label: Quest
description: In Tarren Mill, Melisara seeks the heads of three ogres before Mug'Thol.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Melisara seeks the heads of three ogres before Mug'Thol.

Melisara names Targ, Muckrake and Glommus as Mug'Thol's loyal lieutenants, though she wonders what could make an ogre loyal. You are to kill all three and bring their heads to Tarren Mill. Then only Mug'Thol's head, crown and all, remains to be taken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.
Bring me their heads, friend, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I want their heads, friend, not excuses.

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.
When you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
